prompt: Match each tool to what it reports.
explanation: The slow log records the slowest individual commands; commandstats aggregates per-command calls and CPU; the latency monitor records spike events; MONITOR streams every command live at a heavy cost; and bigkeys samples the keyspace for the largest keys per type.

pairs.right: The slowest recently executed commands with their durations
Per-command call counts and cumulative CPU time
Recorded latency spike events, newest first
A live stream of every command processed, at a heavy overhead
Largest keys per type, found by sampled scanning
